response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment for pneumonia (pneumonie) that occurred during a trip. According to clause A4.1, the insurer covers necessary and appropriate costs for hospitalization resulting from an acute illness during the trip. There is no indication of pre-existing conditions, planned treatment, or any exclusions such as intentional actions, alcohol, or extreme sports. Therefore, the claim is covered under the medical section of the policy."}
